name: diagram-tools
description: Validated interactive Archify system maps plus polished Mermaid rendering with editable source.

interface.shortDescription: Create interactive system maps and Mermaid diagrams.
interface.longDescription: Diagram Tools makes Archify the graphical default for validated interactive architecture and workflow maps while preserving Pretty Mermaid for explicit Mermaid, compact static diagrams, and terminal ASCII. Both lanes retain editable source and use guarded local runtimes.
defaultPrompt: Use $archify to create a validated interactive architecture or workflow map with retained typed JSON source.
Use $pretty-mermaid for explicit Mermaid, compact static diagrams, or terminal ASCII.
Render these Mermaid sources as terminal-friendly ASCII.
